gloss: to reason; to deduce; to infer

definitions.gloss: to reason; to deduce; to infer
definitions.explanation: To use logic and available evidence to arrive at a conclusion. Commonly associated with detective work and mystery fiction, but also used in academic and everyday reasoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{推理|すいり}する。
examples.english: To deduce who the culprit is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{推理|すいり}した。
examples.english: I deduced the course of events from the evidence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{探偵|たんてい}→探偵：07033_tantei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Readers can enjoy reasoning along with the detective.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{推理|すいり}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to reason correctly from limited information.

notes:
Strongly associated with the mystery genre in Japan. ⟦{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}→推理小説：28077_suirishousetsu⟧ (mystery novel) is a major literary genre, and the word appears frequently in discussions of detective fiction, crime dramas, and puzzle-solving games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}→推理小説：28077_suirishousetsu⟧: mystery novel; detective fiction
- ⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: reasoning game; deduction game
- ⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧{力|りょく}: reasoning ability
- ⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧: logical reasoning
- ⟦{推理|すいり}→推理：18951_suiri⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: mystery drama

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推測|すいそく}する→推測する：17957_suisokusuru⟧: to guess, to speculate — less rigorous, based on conjecture
- ⟦{推論|すいろん}→推論：20773_suiron⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to infer — more academic/formal logical deduction
- ⟦{考察|こうさつ}→考察：02736_kousatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to examine, to consider — broader intellectual analysis
